  const edges = [

      { title: "Bacterial-driven odorant receptor expression shifts alter olfactory behaviour (2026)", url: "https://resjournals.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1111/een.70045" }
    ]},

      { title: "RNAi-mediated immune suppression enhances Serratia marcescens pathogenicity (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1007/s10340" },

      { title: "Chitosan nanoparticle-based nucleic acid pesticide system (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1007/s10340-025-01984-1" },
      { title: "Improving fungal biocontrol through binary strain combinations (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1002/ps.71247" },

      { title: "Attractancy potential of terpinen-4-ol and synergistic attractant effects (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.jafc.6c01314" },
      { title: "Lure-and-infect strategy integrating attractants with Beauveria bassiana (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1007/s10340-026-02054-w" }

    ]},

      { title: "B. dorsalis dominance and first report of three Dacus species in Uganda (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1016/j.sciaf.2026.e03286" },
      { title: "Survey parameters to support detection survey design for B. dorsalis (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.2903/sp.efsa.2026.EN-10407" }
    ]},
    { source: "bd", target: "trans", weight: 1, papers: [
      { title: "METTL3/METTL14-mediated RNA m6A modification in male reproductive development (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1111/1744-7917.13510" }
    ]},

    ]},

      { title: "Full-length 16S rRNA gene sequencing reveals variable Medfly gut microbiome features (2026)", url: "https://academic.oup.com/ismecommun/advance-article/doi/10.1093/ismeco/ycag292/8898642" },
      { title: "Dominance of Zygosaccharomyces and shifts in bacterial pathways (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0335811" },
      { title: "Enterobacter supplement and ambient conditions determine sterile male performance (2026)", url: "https://resjournals.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1111/phen.70054" },
      { title: "C. capitata microbiota and its effect on environmental stress tolerance (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1111/1744-7917.70010" },
      { title: "Enterobacter-based dietary supplements affect thermal response of sterile males (2026)", url: "https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/bulletin-of-entomological-research/article/enterobacterbased-dietary-supplements-in-both-larvae-and-adult-diet-affect-thermal-response-of-sterile-males/A1E682C2632276FCC5F8EE472B13DB0B" },
      { title: "Antimicrobial feeding of parental adults reduces offspring tolerance to chemical stress (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1111/aen.70117" }
    ]},
    { source: "cc", target: "gene",  weight: 3, papers: [
      { title: "A novel polymerase III promoter for gene editing in C. capitata (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.04.21.719894" },
      { title: "Generating cisgenic sexing strains in insect pests (2026)", url: "https://www.nature.com/articles/s42003-026-09624-9" },
      { title: "DsiRNA-mediated silencing of transformer leads to masculinisation of XX embryos (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1111/1744-7917.70173" }
    ]},
    { source: "cc", target: "sit",   weight: 3, papers: [

      { title: "Holobiont integrity in C. capitata enhances larval development: implications for SIT (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1111/aen.70063" },
      { title: "Functional validation of a white pupae minimal gene construct in C. capitata (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1111/1744-7917.70058" }
    ]},

      { title: "Analyzing C. capitata dispersal from South to Northward in Turkiye (2026)", url: "https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s12600-025-01350-y" },
      { title: "Urban-agricultural interface and occurrence of Mediterranean fruit fly (2026)", url: "https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s10340-025-01968-1" },
      { title: "Seasonal reinfestation of C. capitata in continental climates (2026)", url: "https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s10341-026-01825-0" },
      { title: "Novel approaches for the detection of low-density Mediterranean fruit fly populations (2026)", url: "https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s10530-026-03917-0" },

      { title: "Sleep bout length and nighttime activity predict longevity in medflies (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1038/s41514-026-00481-8" },

      { title: "Impact of hydric stress during pupal development on adult morphology (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jinsphys.2026.104989" }
    ]},
    { source: "cc", target: "res",   weight: 1, papers: [
      { title: "Reduced fitness cost accounts for stability of malathion-resistant haplotype in field populations (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1002/ps.71269" }
    ]},
    { source: "cc", target: "meth",  weight: 2, papers: [
      { title: "Rapid and non-destructive method to discriminate irradiated C. capitata using near-infrared spectroscopy (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1093/jee/toae290" },
      { title: "Deep learning-based classification of embryonic development stages in C. capitata (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1002/jez.b.70042" }
    ]},
    { source: "cc", target: "nutr",  weight: 2, papers: [
      { title: "Effects of essential amino acids on phagostimulation and reproduction in C. capitata adults (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1111/phen.70063" },
      { title: "Early-life nutrition shapes adult responses to heat and cold in C. capitata (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1017/S0007485326000367" }
    ]},
    { source: "cc", target: "ento",  weight: 1, papers: [
      { title: "From pest to food ingredient: quality of C. capitata larvae submitted to different methods of killing and drying (2026)", url: "https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ifset.2026.104493" }
    ]}

  const W = width
  const H = 540

  const wrap = document.createElement("div")

  const bar = document.createElement("div")
  bar.style.cssText = "font-size:12px;color:#666;margin-bottom:8px;padding:7px 12px;" +
    "background:#f5f5f5;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid #e0e0e0"
  bar.innerHTML = "<strong>How to use:</strong> Hover to highlight connections · " +
    "<strong>Click</strong> a node to see papers below · Click background to reset · Drag to rearrange"
  wrap.appendChild(bar)

  const svgEl = d3.create("svg")
    .attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${W} ${H}`)
    .attr("width", W)
    .attr("height", H)
    .style("font-family", "sans-serif")
    .style("background", "#fafaf8")
    .style("border-radius", "8px")
    .style("border", "1px solid #ddd")
    .style("display", "block")
  wrap.appendChild(svgEl.node())

  const panel = document.createElement("div")
  panel.style.cssText = "margin-top:12px;border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:8px;" +
    "padding:16px 20px;background:#fff;font-family:sans-serif;font-size:13px;display:none"
  wrap.appendChild(panel)

  const nodes = [
    ...species_nodes.map(d => ({...d})),
    ...theme_nodes.map(d => ({...d}))
  ]

  const links = edges.map(e => ({
    ...e,
    source: nodes.find(n => n.id === e.source),
    target: nodes.find(n => n.id === e.target)
  }))

  const maxWeight = d3.max(links, d => d.weight)

  const sim = d3.forceSimulation(nodes)
    .force("link", d3.forceLink(links).id(d => d.id).distance(d => d.target.type === "shared" ? 170 : 140).strength(0.7))
    .force("charge", d3.forceManyBody().strength(-450))
    .force("center", d3.forceCenter(W / 2, H / 2))
    .force("collision", d3.forceCollide().radius(d => d.type === "species" ? 52 : 42))

  const defs = svgEl.append("defs")
  const flt = defs.append("filter").attr("id","shadow").attr("x","-20%").attr("y","-20%").attr("width","140%").attr("height","140%")
  flt.append("feDropShadow").attr("dx",0).attr("dy",2).attr("stdDeviation",3).attr("flood-opacity",0.15)

  const link = svgEl.append("g")
    .selectAll("line").data(links).join("line")
    .attr("stroke", d => d.target.colour)
    .attr("stroke-opacity", 0.4)
    .attr("stroke-width", d => 1.5 + (d.weight / maxWeight) * 7)
    .attr("stroke-linecap", "round")

  const node = svgEl.append("g")
    .selectAll("g").data(nodes).join("g")
    .style("cursor", "pointer")
    .call(d3.drag()
      .on("start", (event, d) => { if (!event.active) sim.alphaTarget(0.3).restart(); d.fx = d.x; d.fy = d.y })
      .on("drag",  (event, d) => { d.fx = event.x; d.fy = event.y })
      .on("end",   (event, d) => { if (!event.active) sim.alphaTarget(0); d.fx = null; d.fy = null })
    )

  node.append("circle")
    .attr("r", d => d.type === "species" ? 42 : 32)
    .attr("fill", d => d.colour)
    .attr("fill-opacity", d => d.type === "species" ? 1 : 0.85)
    .attr("stroke", "#fff").attr("stroke-width", 3)
    .attr("filter", "url(#shadow)")

  node.append("text")
    .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
    .attr("font-size", d => d.type === "species" ? "13px" : "10.5px")
    .attr("font-weight", d => d.type === "species" ? "700" : "600")
    .attr("fill", "#fff").attr("pointer-events", "none")
    .each(function(d) {
      const words = d.label.split(" ")
      const el = d3.select(this)
      if (words.length <= 2 || d.type === "species") {
        el.attr("dy","0.35em").text(d.label)
      } else {
        const mid = Math.ceil(words.length / 2)
        el.append("tspan").attr("x",0).attr("dy","-0.6em").text(words.slice(0,mid).join(" "))
        el.append("tspan").attr("x",0).attr("dy","1.25em").text(words.slice(mid).join(" "))
      }
    })

  node.filter(d => d.type !== "species").append("text")
    .attr("text-anchor","middle").attr("dy","2.8em")
    .attr("font-size","9px").attr("fill","rgba(255,255,255,0.75)").attr("pointer-events","none")
    .text(d => {
      const count = links.filter(l => l.target.id === d.id || l.source.id === d.id).reduce((s,l) => s + l.weight, 0)
      return `${count} paper${count!==1?"s":""}`
    })

  node.on("mouseenter", function(event, d) {
    const connected = new Set([d.id])
    links.forEach(l => { if (l.source.id===d.id) connected.add(l.target.id); if (l.target.id===d.id) connected.add(l.source.id) })
    node.selectAll("circle").attr("fill-opacity", n => connected.has(n.id) ? (n.type==="species"?1:0.95) : 0.2)
    link.attr("stroke-opacity", l => connected.has(l.source.id) && connected.has(l.target.id) ? 0.8 : 0.04)
  })

  node.on("mouseleave", function() {
    node.selectAll("circle").attr("fill-opacity", n => n.type==="species"?1:0.85)
    link.attr("stroke-opacity", 0.4)
  })

  node.on("click", function(event, d) {
    event.stopPropagation()
    const relatedEdges = links.filter(l => l.source.id===d.id || l.target.id===d.id)
    let html = ""
    if (d.type === "species") {
      html = `<div style="font-weight:700;font-size:15px;color:${d.colour};margin-bottom:10px"><em>${d.label}</em> — research themes</div>`
      relatedEdges.forEach(l => {
        html += `<span style="display:inline-block;background:${l.target.colour};color:#fff;border-radius:4px;padding:3px 10px;margin:3px;font-size:12px">${l.target.label} (${l.weight} papers)</span>`
      })
    } else {
      const pbs = {}
      relatedEdges.forEach(l => {
        const key = l.source.id==="bd" ? "B. dorsalis" : "C. capitata"
        const col = l.source.id==="bd" ? "#2E7D9E" : "#C05C28"
        if (!pbs[key]) pbs[key] = { papers: l.papers, colour: col }
      })
      html = `<div style="font-weight:700;font-size:15px;color:${d.colour};margin-bottom:10px">${d.label}</div>`
      Object.entries(pbs).forEach(([sp, {papers, colour}]) => {
        html += `<div style="font-weight:600;font-size:12px;color:${colour};margin:8px 0 4px"><em>${sp}</em></div><ol style="margin:0;padding-left:18px">`
        papers.forEach(p => {
          html += `<li style="margin-bottom:5px">`
          html += p.url ? `<a href="${p.url}" target="_blank" style="color:#2E7D9E;text-decoration:none;font-size:12px">${p.title}</a>`
                       : `<span style="font-size:12px;color:#555">${p.title}</span>`
          html += `</li>`
        })
        html += `</ol>`
      })
    }
    panel.style.display = "block"
    panel.innerHTML = html
  })

  svgEl.on("click", function() {
    node.selectAll("circle").attr("fill-opacity", n => n.type==="species"?1:0.85)
    link.attr("stroke-opacity", 0.4)
    panel.style.display = "none"
  })

  sim.on("tick", () => {
    link.attr("x1",d=>d.source.x).attr("y1",d=>d.source.y).attr("x2",d=>d.target.x).attr("y2",d=>d.target.y)
    node.attr("transform", d => `translate(${Math.max(45,Math.min(W-45,d.x))},${Math.max(45,Math.min(H-45,d.y))})`)
  })

  const lg = svgEl.append("g").attr("transform","translate(16,16)")
  const ld = [
    { colour: "#2E7D9E", label: "B. dorsalis only" },
    { colour: "#C05C28", label: "C. capitata only" },
    { colour: "#7B5EA7", label: "Both species" }
  ]
  ld.forEach((l,i) => {
    lg.append("circle").attr("cx",8).attr("cy",i*22).attr("r",7).attr("fill",l.colour).attr("fill-opacity",0.9)
    lg.append("text").attr("x",20).attr("y",i*22+4).attr("font-size","11px").attr("fill","#444").text(l.label)
  })
  lg.append("text").attr("x",0).attr("y",78).attr("font-size","10px").attr("fill","#999").text("Edge width = paper count")

  yield wrap
}
